about:
Komplete Packaging Service, operating as KPAK, is a contract packaging company headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas, with a second facility in Arlington. The business was founded in 1991 as a small co-packer handling hand-pack work before expanding into automated packaging lines.

Today the company runs roughly 175 packaging machines across about 230,000 square feet of production space. Primary packaging services cover stand-up pouches, pillow pouches, stick packs, overwrap and cartoning, while secondary services include shrink sleeves, shrink wrap, display assembly and kitting. KPAK also offers blending, fulfillment, and frozen and refrigerated warehousing to support end-to-end supply chain needs.

Its customer base spans cosmetics, skincare and food manufacturers seeking co-packing and contract packaging solutions.

KPAK emphasizes its SQF certification and recognition from the American Institute of Baking as markers of its quality and food-safety systems.
